author: Epic Games
description:
Return home to Port Wake and rebuild your family business. 

Docked is a realistic, task-driven simulator where you operate heavy machinery, restore and develop the port's infrastructure, and manage day-to-day operations to help your port expand and thrive.  

After a major ship accident halts operations at Port Wake, restore order with the Deep Waters DLC. Use the magnet gripper attachment, complete 12 new jobs and 1 mission, and upgrade your infrastructure.

Get the Docked Deep Waters DLC with the New Horizons pack now. https://epic.gm/docked-nhpack
title: Docked | Deep Waters Trailer

author: Epic Games
description:
Play the definitive Destiny 2 experience. Available now. https://epic.gm/d2-collection

Destiny 2: The Collection includes all available expansions and content packs in addition to four reward passes as well as access to endgame pursuits such as Raids, Dungeons, and more.   

You are a Guardian, defender of the Last City in a solar system filled with danger and mystery. Choose from three unique classes and dive into Destiny 2’s cinematic adventure featuring thrilling shooter action, incredible abilities, and an unforgettable sci-fi journey that can be experienced alone or with friends. Destiny 2: The Collection unlocks access to all available expansions and content packs including: 

- Forsaken Pack  
- Shadowkeep Pack  
- Beyond Light Pack  
- 30th Anniversary Pack  
- The Witch Queen  
- Lightfall  
- The Final Shape  
- The Edge of Fate + 2 Reward Passes  
- Renegades + 2 Reward Passes  

Access to the dungeons:   
- Shattered Throne   
- Pit of Heresy   
- Grasp of Avarice  
- Dua
title: Destiny 2: The Collection Trailer

description:
Game day is a state of mind.

Step into the modern era of college football where personal ambition meets program pride. Engineer your team with Dynasty Blueprint, take on new positions with deeper customization in Road to Glory and play as your favorite mascots in Mascot Mashup while immersed in the iconic traditions and pageantry of game day.

Pre-purchase EA SPORTS College Football 27 now. https://epic.gm/college-fb-27

author: Epic Games
description:
33 Immortals v1.0 is finally out!

33 Immortals is a co-op action-roguelike for 33 players. Jump straight into runs, solo or with friends. Battle hordes of monsters, defeat massive bosses, and grow stronger each run. Use in-game emotes to coordinate and combine powers with your fellow rebels, and face the Wrath of God, together.

The full 1.0 release introduces:
- All 3 fully playable worlds
- The ultimate final boss encounter
- New enemies, mechanics, and challenges
- Gameplay polish and balancing updates
- Expanded customization options
- Quality-of-life improvements throughout the game

Experience the complete journey of 33 Immortals from beginning to end.

It’s time to join the rebellion against the Wrath of God.

Play now. https://epic.gm/33-immortals
